purpose: Direct upstream diagnosis in one disposable Hermes instance, bypassing aiagent-gateway; intentionally sends synthetic requests before startup restore completes.

source_explanation.gateway/run_inbound.py: Startup restore queues the inbound event and returns without a reply.
source_explanation.plugins/platforms/a2a/adapter.py: on_processing_complete resolves a successful no-reply event as an empty completed task.
source_explanation.gateway/run_startup.py: The end-of-startup log marker follows _finish_startup_restore; the running status and open ports precede it.
